dialogue.text: Good morning! May I see your passport and ticket, please?
Are you checking any bags today?
Yes, just this suitcase. And I have one carry-on backpack.
Excuse me, sir. Please take your laptop out of your bag for the scanner.
Oh, sure! I forgot about that. Here it is.

questions.question: What documents did the agent ask for? (شنو هما الوثائق لي طلب الموظف؟)
options: ID card and hotel reservation (البطاقة الوطنية وحجز الفندق)

questions.question: How many bags is the passenger checking in? (شحال من فاليزا بغا يسجيل فالساقية؟)
What did security ask the passenger to take out? (شنو طلب منه الأمن يخرج من الصاك؟)
